question: The selling price of 150 items is equal to the cost price of 125 items. What will be the percentage loss?
solution:
```html

**Given:**

The selling price of 150 items is equal to the cost price of 125 items.

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Loss = (Cost Price - Selling Price)/(Cost Price) times 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of 1 item be C.

Cost price of 125 items = 125 × C

Selling price of 150 items = 125 × C

Selling price of 1 item = (125C)/(150)

Selling price of 1 item = (5C)/(6)

Loss per item = C - (5C)/(6)

Loss per item = (C)/(6)

Percentage Loss = (frac{C)/(6)}{C} times 100

Percentage Loss = (1)/(6) times 100

Percentage Loss = 162/3%

**The percentage loss is 16²/₃%.**

``
